$comment: Everything the code needs in order to behave like your division, and nothing else.
Content, links and translations are not configuration: they live in the database and in locales/.
Copy this file to division.json and edit it. It is versioned on purpose: it is behaviour, not a secret.
$comment.code: Your division code as IVAO writes it, 2 or 3 upper case letters. Staff positions are matched as ^{code}-.
$comment.countryId: ISO country used to ask the IVAO API for your FIRs and airports.
$comment.name: Division name, one entry per language listed in locales.
$comment.domain: Public host of the division, used to build absolute links.
$comment.locales: Languages of the division. Every one of them needs a locales/{lang}/ directory.
$comment.defaultLocale: Fallback language. It must be one of locales.
$comment.timezone: IANA time zone, used to show local times next to UTC.
$comment.icaoPrefixes: Safety net for filters and validation; FIRs and airports themselves come from the IVAO API.
$comment.modules: Optional modules only. The department modules and the editorial core are always on.
$comment.superAdmins: Bootstrap only: read once, when no super administrator exists yet. After that the database is the truth.
$comment.firStaffScope: all = FIR teams work on every FIR (default). own = each FIR team only sees its own FIR.
